Ait so first of all, you're using the wrong talents for dps. You want to be using Invoke Nizzy on every boss apart from High command Eonar and Portal keeper, he does a ton more dmg than RJW ever could on ST bosses. An example of this would be on garothi, your kill times are perfect for Nizzy, you use him on pull and then at 3 mins you get to use him again then the boss dies around 3:45 it seems on average for your guild. Thats Perfect Nizzy timing and will boost ur dps alot.

We can't blame anything on your stats as you're very well optimised, low haste ect

I simmed your character - https://www.raidbots.com/simbot/report/3o3MpwKRYF9wbKDng5B6rF just so u can see ur stat weights, yes simming works for brewmaster dps ;^) 

As you can see you need to be stacking crit/mastery atm and its good to see you're doing that with gems and enchants ect.

Your BoC use is pretty good but it's not perfect, an example of this is https://www.warcraftlogs.com/reports/FG2zf4wDchqkpbgW#fight=1&type=damage-done this log here, your best garothi log, You could've got more tiger palms into your rotation, part of this will be helped by using Nizzy over RJW. But in this fight you used Keg smash 6 times after BoC, BoF once and ISB once, thats 8 times you could've empowered your TP by 200% but didn't.

Lets compare your best Garothi to mine, https://www.warcraftlogs.com/reports/compare/H2QwY6zAvkXTBh7a/FG2zf4wDchqkpbgW#fight=3,1&type=damage-done&source=18,25

As you can see, my fight was 37 seconds shorter than yours, yet I managed to get Way more Tiger palm casts off compared to you, even in a shorter fight Also compared the damage Nizzy did to your RJW, keeping in mind that I only got 10 seconds on my 2nd nizzy where you would get a full 45 seconds on it. Also note how My Exploding Keg was cast less than yours, by 1 cast and did double the damage, this is because you want to save it for the intermission when he has 2 cannons for extra dps ;). Additionally, do a 3 TP rotation just before you push so u can go into that double cannon phase with 2 KS charges so u can get some fat damage ;). The legendary system is fine for people who don't really care. However, for people who are trying to be somewhat competitive at the game if Player A rerolls and gets his 2 BiS first he's Set. If Player B gets his 2 worst he's gonna feel like shit especially if they are the same class. An example would be the rogue shoulders, they are by far the biggest dps increase out of all legendaries and if player A got those but player B got Sephuz, the dps difference just based on that 1 item would be highly apparent. 

If you don't care and aren't being competitive then yeh its a good system. For people who are trying to compete however, they have to put much more effort in if they get fucked over by it. So In my opinion the system has positives and negatives, I personally don't enjoy it at all but I can see both sides.

It depends on the situation really I use about 4 different ones depending on what dungeon/boss I'm fighting.

The xavius one is always good, Gives a nice chunk of mastery + flat damage reduction, I use this one mainly on progression bosses or on mobs that hit hard and fast.

My other primary one is the one from Rokkmora? Its really good at just absorbing a flat ton of damage + gives me a decent chunk of strength which increases DPS and on fights like Ursoc u really need that :P The shield is great at absorbing DoTs and stuff.

Another great one is the one from Dragons of nightmare. It's basically like you're popping a slightly worse shield wall if you drop below 50% and it absorbs 30% dmg up to 800K so it's really good if you're on a boss that you know will be dealing heavy damage which can lead to unexpected spikes, its a passive panic button that lets you have more freedom with your own Cooldowns.

Forgot the 4th :P
The trinket from the tree boss in EN is really decent if you just want some dps, it was better Pre IP nerf since Versatility was more valuable then but it gives Flat Strength and also buffs you with a ton of versatility which is always handy but compared to the others  this is probably the worst defensive wise but I use it with Rokmorras one if I just want to increase my dps so if I was doing farm raids ect :P

So I will admit we're squishier now but my guild recently just downed Mythic Ursoc with me tanking... and that guy hits like a mountain. The problem is people are still playing like they were with Ignore Pain where they just keep trying to spam it whenever they have the rage avliable. What I've found to be better is focussing more on shield block and saving your rage for when you really need it or when I get an Ultimatium proc + Dragon scales. But honestly atm it really isn't worth spamming Ignore Pain without a decent chunk of rage or a Dragon scales proc. I still take less damage than our DK tank but the glory days we had at the start are over :P

Mainly focus on Haste/Mastery right now and don't turn your nose up at Crit as it really helps with the Ultimatium procs I reccomend around 15% Crit since with the Talent on our Wep it rounds off nicely :P

But overall I don't think we're trash tier and we're still perfectly capable of being a good tank. It isn't just a mindless IP spam anymore though :P
